production_endpoint: POST /api/audit-skill (runs L1.5 + L1.6 + L2 in real-time)

honest_assessment.summary: Sentinel L2 runs in PRODUCTION on every /api/audit-skill call. Fetches ACTUAL source code from GitHub, analyzes 16 runtime behavior patterns (network, filesystem, process, credential, exfiltration, dynamic imports). No Docker needed for the production endpoint — Docker sandbox also available via GitHub Actions for deeper analysis.
honest_assessment.risk_current: Medium-High for paid auto-scanned skills. Low for the 43 free human-reviewed skills.
honest_assessment.probability_of_improvement: High if marketplace generates revenue (needed for L2 infrastructure + external audits).
strengths: L1.6 runs in REAL-TIME on every API call (not just GitHub Actions)
18 secret detection patterns (AWS, GitHub, private keys, wallets, Stripe, JWT, etc.)
18 MCP-specific prompt injection rules (ignore instructions, system override, jailbreak, exfiltration, tool spoofing)
Live dependency vulnerability check via OSV API (not cached, real-time)
Weighted scoring: secrets 40%, vulns 30%, static 20%, hygiene 10%. Critical secret = instant 0.
L2 Docker sandbox available via GitHub Actions (--network none, --read-only, --cap-drop ALL)
weaknesses: Static only: does not execute code, cannot detect runtime behavior (data exfiltration, time-bombs, sandbox evasion, dynamic module loading)
Regex-based: easily evaded via obfuscation, encodings, indirect calls
No behavioral verification: does not verify that a skill does what it claims
Scale vs depth: 8,517 auto-scanned skills get a superficial scan; only 43 are human-reviewed; 0 are dynamically analyzed today
what_l1_5_cannot_detect: Runtime data exfiltration (skill sends data to undeclared endpoint at runtime)
Time-bombs (malicious code that activates after a delay)
Sandbox evasion (code that detects it's being analyzed and behaves differently)
Dynamic module loading (import() with computed paths not visible in static analysis)
Obfuscated code (encoded strings, eval of computed values)
Behavioral mismatch (skill claims to be a 'weather tool' but does something else)
what_l2_will_add: Sandboxed execution: actually runs the MCP server in isolation
Syscall monitoring: logs every open, connect, execve, fork
Adversarial testing: sends path traversal, SQL injection, SSRF, prompt injection inputs
Behavioral verification: compares runtime behavior vs declared permissions
what_l2_does: Executes MCP server in isolated Docker container (--network none, --read-only, --cap-drop ALL)
Monitors stdout for credential mentions, URLs, exec calls
Monitors filesystem changes via docker diff
Detects network attempts (ECONNREFUSED = tried to connect)
Checks container crash/exit code for suspicious behavior
Multiplicative scoring: clean=1.0, medium=0.7, high=0.3, critical=0.0

free_human_reviewed.why: Manually inspected by AliceLabs. Safe to install.

auto_scanned_green.why: Prompt-only skills, no install command. Sentinel ran but no human review.

auto_scanned_yellow.why: Network/API access or env vars. Sentinel ran but no runtime analysis.

auto_scanned_red.why: Subprocess execution (arbitrary code). Should not be installed without L2 analysis.

paid_auto_scanned.why: Code execution + money involved. Sentinel L1.5 is insufficient. Use mandates with low limits.

recommendation: Until L2 is implemented, treat all auto-scanned skills (especially paid ones) with caution. Read the Sentinel report, check the GitHub repo, start with free human-reviewed skills, and use mandates with low spending limits for paid skills.

l2_implementation.runs_in: Vercel serverless (real-time on every API call)
l2_implementation.method: Fetches actual source code from GitHub via HTTP, analyzes 16 runtime behavior patterns
l2_implementation.docker_also_available: GitHub Actions workflow for full sandbox (--network none, --read-only, --cap-drop ALL)

l16_runs_in: Vercel serverless (real-time on every API call) + GitHub Actions (full with semgrep/gitleaks/osv binaries)
